title: Veer Na Main Teri Qabar Banawan
body:
Veer na main teri qabar banawan
Ya shaam nu jawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaway Zainab ujri
Jung karbala di muk gai
Lutiyaan gayiaan ridawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Kiwaain shaam lajawan
Sajjad beemar Ai
Hosh nai aundi esnoon
Ai sakhat lachaar Ai
Mainu samajh nai aundi
Veeran disaan main kiwain
Enu mot ton bachawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Uth to mai lath gayeaan
par roo nai sakdi,
lash utay pathraan da
mai dhair han takadee
meray haath paband hin
keway lash to mai teree
pathraan nu aa hatawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Paa paa khaak siraan wich
Es waal lukayaaye
Umaat nay rassiyaan day
Saanu zewar paye
Main suneya ay veerun
Hayee shaam de sheer diyaan
Baoon okhiiyaan nai rawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaam shahar vich kisnay
Sade pardey banonay,
Muloona de majmay
saday ra cho hatonay
mera ghazi veeran
ja naher de kinaray
Samya kata ke bawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar dunya fani
Ek din muk janee
Rehni Aye do jag tay
Syedaan di kahani
Ank kool kay Dunya
Pursay no kaim rakhna
Zahra diyaan duawan
